messages:
Elliot: heads up — restore for tenant-88 failed at 06:12 UTC with KMS decrypt errors :rotating_light:
Elliot: logs show `AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd-1234` when trying to restore snapshot s3://redwood-backups/tenant-88/2026-03-21.snap
Maya: ack. is this after the CMK rotation yesterday?
Elliot: yes, rotation completed at ~02:00 UTC and the rotation script ran its last step which pruned grants. restore job kicked off later this morning.
David: likely cause = rotation removed the duplicate grant for the snapshot-uploader role. pipeline assumed grant mirroring existed elsewhere. we should confirm grant history in CloudTrail for kms:CreateGrant/RetireGrant 
Sam: quick mitigation: create a temporary grant for the snapshot role so current restore can finish, then we can do a controlled re-encrypt if needed. example command:
```
aws kms create-grant \
  --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-1234 \
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/snapshot-uploader \
  --operations Decrypt,Encrypt,GenerateDataKey
```
Sam: that returns a GrantId and GrantToken — pass the token to the restore process or make the grant persistent.
Maya: are we comfortable creating a long-lived grant? last time that was a vector for lateral access. prefer short TTL + audit.
Elliot: agreed — make it TTL 12h and annotate the grant with a tag `incident=tenant-88-restore` so we can detect and auto-retire.
encops-bot: suggested_runbook_update: add step "mirror grants to snapshot-uploader before CMK rotation" to reduce blast radius.
David: longer-term fix: update rotation pipeline to do a two-phase swap: (1) provision new key and mirror grants (2) update uploader role to accept new key (3) retire old grants + key alias cutover. This avoids a period where grants are missing.
Sam: also propose adding an allowlist/transition role that always keeps decrypt rights during rotation windows. Could be a small managed role used only by restore workflows.
Maya: we need audit + alerting: CloudTrail already logs CreateGrant/RetireGrant but it's noisy. propose a detective rule: alert when a rotation retire removes all grants for a CMK and there are recent snapshot restore attempts in the last 48h.
Elliot: good. action items:
- Sam: create temporary 12h grant now and return GrantId in thread (ETA 15m)
- David: run CloudTrail query to capture CreateGrant/RetireGrant events for key abcd-1234 and attach timeline (ETA 30m)
- Maya: draft runbook changes and detection rule for SOC (ETA EOD)
- Elliot: coordinate with support to inform tenant-88 of expected restore window (ETA 20m)
Sam: creating grant now. giving GrantId: 1a2b3c4d and GrantToken provided to the restore job.
Elliot: restore resumed at 06:30 UTC and currently showing progress. monitor for Decrypt errors.
David: pulled CloudTrail slice — rotation script retired 3 grants at 02:05 UTC and there were no mirror-create events prior. attaching the query snippet here:
```
# CloudTrail insights query (simplified)
SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.keyId 
FROM $YOUR_TRAIL WHERE eventName IN ('CreateGrant','RetireGrant') AND requestParameters.keyId LIKE '%abcd-1234%'
```
Maya: vulnerability note — rotation code assumed idempotent grant creation but race conditions can drop grants if multiple runners operate. treat as vuln: rotation-script-grant-race. open a ticket, assign to infra.
encops-bot: created ticket ENCOPS-7321 with title "rotation-script-grant-race — ensure grant mirroring & idempotency"
Sam: postmortem next steps we should include:
- short-term: add TTL-tagged temporary grant and manual verify restores for last 72h of snapshots
- medium-term: rotation pipeline change (two-phase swap + mirrored grants)
- long-term: automate grant mirroring + unit tests / canary that attempts decrypts after rotation before retiring old grants
Elliot: agreed. please also add a log enrichment so restore failures include GrantId/GrantToken stub in metrics to speed triage.
Maya: mapping of RBAC -> KMS grants needs doc. I'll own a one-pager and link to rotation pipeline PR.
Elliot: thanks all. closing once restore completes and ENCOPS-7321 has an owner with ETA.
David: restore finished at 06:48 UTC, tenant-88 data validated. will follow up with the rotation pipeline PR link once drafted.
Maya: noted, will add detection rule to SOC playbook and ping infra for the PR review. :thumbsup:
